modules.title: Introduction to Nnọchiaha (Pronouns)
modules.html:
Personal and possessive pronouns in Igbo. This section covers introduction to nnọchiaha (pronouns).

Key points

  • Kpọọ aha nkejiasụsụ na-akọwa aha ma ọ bụ nnọchiaha _____. — Nkọwa.
  • Olee n'ime ndị a bụ nnọchiaha (Pronoun) — Anyị.
  • Olee nke bụ nnọchiaha (Pronoun) n'ime ndị a — Ha.
  • Chọpụta 'Nnọchiaha' n'ahịrịokwu a: 'Obi riri ji'. — O nweghị nnọchiaha.
  • Kedu aha ọzọ a na-akpọ 'Nnọchiaha' — Pronoun.

Worked examples

Q: Kpọọ aha nkejiasụsụ na-akọwa aha ma ọ bụ nnọchiaha _____.
A: Nkọwa — An adjective (nkọwa) is a word that describes or qualifies a noun (aha) or pronoun (nnọchiaha).

Q: Olee n'ime ndị a bụ nnọchiaha (Pronoun)?
A: Anyị — 'Anyị' (We/Us) is a first-person plural pronoun.

examples.q: Kpọọ aha nkejiasụsụ na-akọwa aha ma ọ bụ nnọchiaha _____.

quiz.q: Kpọọ aha nkejiasụsụ na-akọwa aha ma ọ bụ nnọchiaha _____.
quiz.solution: An adjective (nkọwa) is a word that describes or qualifies a noun (aha) or pronoun (nnọchiaha).

quiz.q: Olee n'ime ndị a bụ nnọchiaha (Pronoun)?
quiz.solution: 'Anyị' (We/Us) is a first-person plural pronoun.

quiz.q: Olee nke bụ nnọchiaha (Pronoun) n'ime ndị a?
quiz.solution: 'Ha' (They) stands in for a noun, making it a pronoun.

quiz.q: Chọpụta 'Nnọchiaha' n'ahịrịokwu a: 'Obi riri ji'.
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: O nweghị nnọchiaha.

quiz.q: Kedu aha ọzọ a na-akpọ 'Nnọchiaha'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Pronoun.

quiz.q: Kedu otu a na-esi asị mmadụ 'Nnọọ' n'Igbo Izugbe?
quiz.solution: 'Nnọọ' is the formal welcome or greeting in Standard Igbo.

quiz.q: Olee n'ime ndị a bụ nnọchianahe (pronoun)?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: M.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Akụkọ ifo'?
quiz.solution: Folktales (Akụkọ ifo) are fictional stories passed down orally, usually involving animals and intended to teach morals.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ uru 'Ịmụ ọrụ' (Apprenticeship) baara ndị Igbo?
options: Ọ na-enyere ndị ntorobịa aka ịmụta aka ọrụ na inwe onwe ha
Ọ na-eme ka mmadụ bụrụ onye ohi
Ọ bụ maka ndị na-agaghị ụlọ akwụkwọ nani
quiz.solution: The Igbo apprenticeship system (Igba boi) is globally recognized for fostering entrepreneurship and job creation.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Nsonazụ' (Suffix)?
quiz.solution: A suffix (nsonazụ) is added to the end of a word root to modify its meaning or function.

quiz.q: Gịnị ka a na-akpọ nwa mụrụ n'ụbọchị 'Eke'?
quiz.solution: A female child born on Eke market day is named Mgbeke.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ isiokwu 'Mbem'?
quiz.solution: Mbem usually focuses on praise (Otito), history, or prayers/incantations (Ọfọ).

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Ego nwaanyị'?
quiz.solution: Bride price is a symbolic token establishing the legal bond between families.

quiz.q: Onye na-akpụ ígwè bụ _____.
quiz.solution: A blacksmith is called 'Onye òkpụ ígwè'.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Plural'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Ọtụtụ.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Sun'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Anyanwụ.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Mouth'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Ọnụ.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Mother'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Nne.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Bag'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Akpa.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Nna'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Father.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Anyanwụ'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Sun.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Nri'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Food.

quiz.q: Wanne sarki ne ya shahara a Kano?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Muhammadu Rumfa.

quiz.q: Wanne ne 'Aikatau'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Verb.

quiz.q: Wanne ne kalmar 'Namiji'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Male.

quiz.q: Menene 'Littafi'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Book.

quiz.q: Kedu ka a na-akpọ 'Traditional Title' n'Igbo?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Echichi.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Water' n'Igbo?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Mmiri.

quiz.q: Olee n'ime ndị a bụ nri?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Akpụ.

quiz.q: Ọnye bụ isi na nzukọ gọọmentị obodo n'ala Igbo tupu ndị ọcha abịa?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Amala.

quiz.q: Tụgharịa 'Good morning' n'Igbo:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Ị bọọla chi.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Chair'?
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Oche.
